gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients must have pathologic confirmation of a glioblastoma or gliosarcoma diagnosis at initial surgery or second or later surgery

candidate_evidence.quote: Progesterone may help control tumor growth and spread in patients with glioblastoma.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: This analysis will be performed to determine what plasma drug levels can be achieved in recurrent glioblastoma (GBM) patients

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: YKL-40 will be quantitated at the specific time points (pre-treatment, 4 weeks, 8 weeks) with specific levels and changes in levels recorded.

role_evidence.quote: [EXPERIMENTAL] Treatment (progesterone): Patients receive progesterone SC QD for up to 24 weeks

source_quote.quote: Original tumor and any recurrent tumor samples will be assessed for progesterone receptor expression levels by immunohistochemistry
Each of the tumor mutational and genomic loss/gain factors will be scored

coder_notes: EARLY_PHASE1 record. SC route of natural progesterone coded new_route (usual routes are other). PK is plasma only so tumour_pk_planned no. Serum markers (YKL-40, MMP-9, GFAP, CRP, sCD14, sCD23) are not tumour molecular biomarkers and are not listed; they are measured pre/4/8 weeks but not linked to a progesterone target, hence target_engagement unclear.
